about: COV-TIME (feat/cov-time-session): B1 "1440" is "D" for time(tf, session) and the time(tf) anchor, and nowhere else (Q-BT2 vw-bt-time-1440-spy-{1d,60}-2026-11-16); B2 a v1-v3 bare `interval` is timeframe.multiplier, v4+ refused; B3 ta.swma / v4 swma over runtime state is the published pine_swma. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: the session clock reads "1440" through the request spelling map again (no alias)
mutants.from: const code = lit === null ? null : clockTfCodeOf(lit)

mutants.mutant: the time(tf) anchor reads "1440" through the request spelling map again (no alias)
mutants.from: const tfCode = rawTf === null ? null : clockTfCodeOf(rawTf)

mutants.mutant: "1440" leaks into PINE_TF_SPELLING, so time_close / timeframe.change / request.security read it as "D" with no capture
mutants.expectRed: is NOT a spelling anywhere else

mutants.mutant: a bare `interval` is read as timeframe.multiplier in v4+ too
mutants.expectRed: v4, v5 and v6 keep the refusal

mutants.mutant: a v1-v3 bare `interval` is not served (the refusal it had)
swma's weights on x[3] and x[2] are swapped (2/6 and 1/6)
ta.swma over runtime state is not respelled (the refusal it had)
